title: Group Anagrams
description: Group strings that are anagrams of each other.

data.text: Given an array of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. Return the grouped list in any order.

data.title: Sorted key O(n * k log k)
Frequency key O(n * k)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n * k log k) → O(n * k). **Space:** We avoid sorting each word. The frequency key uniquely identifies anagrams without reordering.
